title: Canonical bit-string representative
statement: For a code format $F$ and a bit string $x$, define its canonical representative as follows: if scanning $x$ succeeds and returns a tail $t$, take the prefix of $x$ obtained by removing the final $|t|$ bits. If scanning fails, use the serialization of the format’s fallback code.
